result.summary: PASS. No Critical, High or Medium finding; three Low findings, none blocks. Q1 (cause or symptom): data only, nothing is caught, bypassed or silenced; the two colours that failed are replaced by the method of the design and the check enforces them; the edit of the missing tag is a real removal, not an empty value. Q3 (more than ordered): the file list equals the write set; no engine, server, tenants, public, older demo tenant or older demo answer changed; no generator or stray file in the project; only the README paragraph was added. Q4 (quality bar): no skip, no switched-off rule, no hidden exit code, no secret, no address; Q6, Q7, Q8 (no shared id or text, no colour shared), Q10, Q11 and R3 are met or not applicable as the design says; the security items were left to the security gate.
